info.title: API.SH: BrickLink
info.description: The BrickLink API from API.SH: public BrickLink data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One catalog item: internal id, type, number, name, year released, weight, dimensions, instructions, category path, what it consists of (part and minifigure counts), where it appears (sets, minifigures, parts...), known colors with how often each appears, default color, inventory flag and images.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bricklink-item

parameters.name: no
parameters.description: Item number, e.g. 75192-1 (set), 3001 (part), sw0001a (minifigure); or a bricklink.com catalog link in `url`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Item type (set numbers like 75192-1 are recognised without it).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A bricklink.com catalog item link instead of type + no.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every store lot offering an item: condition, completeness (complete, incomplete, sealed), quantity, price (US dollars) and the store's own price, quantity tiers, description, color, store name, username, feedback score, country and minimum buy. Filter by color, condition, ships-to country, seller country or region, price range, minimum quantity and no-minimum stores; sort by price, quantity or newest. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bricklink-item-for-sale

parameters.name: ships_to
parameters.description: Only stores that ship to this country (2 letters).

parameters.name: no_minimum
parameters.description: Only stores without a minimum order.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The full inventory of a set, minifigure or gear item: every part, minifigure, extra, counterpart and alternate item with quantity, item number, color, name, match id and image, plus the summary of lots and pieces per section and the catalog's notes. `view` can break sub-sets and minifigures into their parts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bricklink-item-inventory

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The price guide for an item (or one color of a part): the last six months of sales, new and used, with times sold, total quantity and min/average/quantity-average/max prices, and every sale grouped by month; plus the current items for sale, new and used, with the same summary and every lot's quantity and price. Prices are in US dollars; lots listed in another currency are marked `converted`. For the most traded parts the lot lists are long: they are cut after the first few thousand lots (`lots_truncated: true`; the summaries are always complete), and `summary_only=true` returns just the four summaries.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bricklink-item-price-guide

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Internal item id instead of type + no.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color id (needed for parts; see known_colors on /bricklink/v1/item).

parameters.name: seller_country
parameters.description: Only sellers in this country (2 letters).

parameters.name: summary_only
parameters.description: Only the four summaries (sales and for sale, new and used), without the lot lists.

parameters.name: seller_region
parameters.description: Only sellers in this region (see search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the BrickLink catalog (sets, parts, minifigures, books, gear, catalogs, instructions, original boxes). Each item: internal item id, type, item number, name, category, image, and the marketplace's new and used quantity, seller count and min/max price. Filter by type, condition, color, category, year range, seller country or region, price range and in-stock; sort by match, price, quantity, sellers or name. Without `type`, the first page of every type is returned with per-type counts; with `type`, pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bricklink-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only this item type (needed for paging).

parameters.name: cond
parameters.description: Only items for sale in this condition.

parameters.name: seller_region
parameters.description: Seller region: 1 Asia, 2 Africa, 3 North America, 4 South America, 5 Middle East, 6 Europe, 7 Australia & Oceania, -1 European Union.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
